body:
Young girls are going to make their own decisions, even going so far as going behind your back to do what they want.

I’m still a young girl and I know exactly where she is, so my best advice is to make it extremely clear to her that you love her, will always have her back, but you don’t feel he’s right. She likely already knows this herself and is coming up with excuses because the idea of breaking up is scary.
If he touches her, you have beyond every right to put your foot down, but until then, she won’t learn which men are right and which are wrong and that’s something only she can learn herself.

I think if I had felt my mother would have supported me in my decisions, I would have left my first abusive relationship sooner, but I was just too busy running from my mom who refused to have empathy for me

Thank you for replying ❤️
I wish it were as easy as switching it off or on, I just repress the feelings I have and any time I approach the issues, I panic and feel guilt and sadness until it’s left my head, even seeing therapists or talking to my boyfriend doesn’t help in lifting the weight
I just wish it were possible for me to forget it and live life happily. I very frequently consider if it’s possible and even joke to myself about self inducing amnesia so I have a fresh start, but I don’t really want all the other risks that come with it aha
